text:
Create a vertical 29-second ManimGL animation inspired by a minimalist “animation versus geometry” action scene.

Use:

from manimlib import *

Output format:
- Vertical video
- Resolution: 1080 x 1920
- Frame rate: 30 FPS
- Black background
- Bright orange stick figure
- White mathematical geometry
- Thin white ground lines
- Smooth cinematic camera movement
- Strong glow, impact particles, motion trails, and fast action timing

The animation should be divided into the following sequence.

SCENE 1: TITLE INTRO, 0–3 seconds

Show a black screen.

Display a glowing title near the upper section:

“ANIMATION VS. GEOMETRY”

Below it, display:

“PROOF MOTION”

Use white text with a warm orange highlight and soft glow.

Fade the title in, hold briefly, then gradually reduce its opacity while the action begins.

SCENE 2: INTRODUCE THE CHARACTER, 1–4 seconds

Draw a thin horizontal white ground line across the screen.

Place a small glowing orange stick figure on the left.

Construct the figure using separate animated body parts:

- circular head
- torso
- upper and lower arms
- upper and lower legs

Do not treat the entire character as one rigid object.

The figure should begin crouched, rise slightly, look to the right, and prepare to move.

Use subtle breathing and head movement so it feels alive.

SCENE 3: INTRODUCE THE GEOMETRIC OPPONENT, 2–5 seconds

Create a white wireframe geometric orb on the right.

The orb should look like a chaotic mathematical polyhedron made from:

- an outer circular or polygonal boundary
- 14 to 20 visible vertices
- many connecting chords
- thin glowing white lines
- small glowing vertex dots
- random tiny white particles around it

The orb should rotate slowly and vibrate slightly.

It should look unstable, intelligent, and threatening.

SCENE 4: FIRST REACTION, 4–7 seconds

The orange figure notices the orb.

Animate the figure using clear poses:

1. upright observation
2. slight backward lean
3. crouched anticipation
4. fast forward movement

The figure should run toward the right using a proper pose-to-pose run cycle.

The run cycle must include:

- contact pose
- compression pose
- passing pose
- takeoff pose
- airborne pose
- opposite contact pose

Important running details:

- clear forward torso lean
- long front and back leg separation
- opposite arm and leg movement
- bent elbows
- brief flight phase with both feet above the ground
- vertical hip bounce
- no foot sliding
- visible acceleration

Add a short orange motion trail behind the body.

SCENE 5: MATHEMATICAL SYMBOL APPEARS, 6–9 seconds

Create a glowing white phi symbol:

φ

Place it on the ground line ahead of the orange figure.

The figure slows down, bends toward it, and examines it.

The phi symbol should pulse softly.

Add a brief number-line construction beneath or beside it.

Show small white points and simple markings along the ground.

The figure should touch or interact with the phi symbol.

SCENE 6: GEOMETRIC ORB ATTACKS, 9–14 seconds

The wireframe orb begins moving aggressively toward the character.

Increase its scale slightly while it approaches.

Increase its rotation speed.

Add:

- white debris
- jittering internal lines
- outward particles
- a stronger white glow
- subtle camera shake

The orange figure reacts and begins running away.

The running animation should become faster over several cycles.

Use three stages of acceleration:

- first cycle: cautious
- second cycle: faster
- third cycle: full sprint

The figure should lean more strongly forward as speed increases.

SCENE 7: CHASE SHOT, 12–16 seconds

Create a dynamic chase composition.

The orange figure runs from left to right while the large white wireframe orb follows closely.

Keep the camera centered between them.

The orb should fill more of the frame as it gets closer.

Add orange motion trails behind the runner and white particles behind the orb.

Keep the ground line visible.

The runner should look back briefly while continuing to run.

SCENE 8: GEOMETRY MODIFIES THE ENVIRONMENT, 15–18 seconds

Introduce a diagonal white geometric line or ramp.

Place the phi symbol on or near this sloped line.

The flat ground should transform into a mathematical construction.

Animate this transition using smooth line transformations.

The environment should feel as if geometry is changing the rules of the world.

The orange figure should reach the ramp, lose balance, and be launched upward.

SCENE 9: IMPACT, 17–20 seconds

Create a strong impact between the character and the geometric construction.

At the impact point, add:

- bright white flash
- radial particle burst
- short camera shake
- orange body motion streak
- brief freeze frame
- fast follow-through

The figure should rotate horizontally while flying through the air.

The wireframe orb should remain below and continue rotating.

SCENE 10: GOLDEN-RATIO CONSTRUCTION, 20–23 seconds

Transition into a large golden-ratio rectangle construction.

Build nested rectangles and squares based on the Fibonacci sequence.

Use thin white lines.

Draw a smooth golden spiral through the nested squares.

The construction should occupy most of the vertical frame.

Place the orange figure on one of the upper edges.

The figure should appear very small compared with the structure.

SCENE 11: ROTATING MATHEMATICAL WORLD, 22–26 seconds

Rotate the entire golden-ratio structure slowly in 2D or pseudo-3D.

Zoom the camera inward.

The orange figure should slide, run, or fall along the edges of the nested rectangles.

The golden spiral should guide the viewer’s attention toward the center.

Add a subtle warm golden glow at the center of the spiral.

The structure should feel recursive and increasingly deep.

SCENE 12: FALL INTO RECURSION, 25–28 seconds

The figure moves toward progressively smaller squares.

Animate the camera following the nested geometry.

Increase the scale of the inner region as the camera zooms in.

The orange figure should fall or crawl toward the final central square.

Keep the motion fast but readable.

SCENE 13: FINAL TRAP, 28–29 seconds

Show the figure trapped near the smallest central square.

Display a glowing phi symbol:

φ

Place the symbol inside or above the final square.

The orange figure should crouch, look exhausted, and remain still.

Fade the surrounding geometry and character into black.

End the video cleanly.

VISUAL STYLE

Use this color system:

Background:
#000000

Orange character:
#FF6A00

Orange glow:
#FF8A00 with low opacity

Geometry:
#F5F5F5

Subtle geometry:
#AAAAAA

Golden center:
#FFD54A

Use layered copies for glow:

- original stroke width around 4 to 6
- glow copy width around 12 to 18
- glow opacity around 0.08 to 0.18

CHARACTER ANIMATION REQUIREMENTS

Build the stick figure as a reusable rig.

Create separate joints for:

- shoulder
- elbow
- wrist
- hip
- knee
- ankle

Create helper methods such as:

make_stick_figure()
set_pose()
animate_run_cycle()
animate_crouch()
animate_jump()
animate_impact()
animate_fall()

The running cycle should use clear extreme poses rather than simply sliding the figure.

Use approximately 8 poses per full run cycle.

Make planted feet remain fixed during ground contact to avoid skating.

GEOMETRIC ORB REQUIREMENTS

Create the orb procedurally.

Use a circular set of vertices.

Connect many randomly selected pairs of vertices.

Add:

- outer boundary
- vertex dots
- internal chords
- rotating glow layer
- particle fragments

Animate the orb using rotation, scaling, vibration, and slight deformation.

CAMERA REQUIREMENTS

Use MovingCameraScene or InteractiveScene camera controls.

Use:

- slow zooms
- chase tracking
- fast impact shake
- slight rotation during golden-ratio sequence
- smooth return to stable framing

Do not move the camera continuously without purpose.

Use camera motion only to direct attention.

TIMING

Total duration: approximately 29 seconds.

Use fast action timing:

- normal movement: 0.3 to 0.8 seconds
- running pose transitions: 0.05 to 0.08 seconds
- impact: 0.15 to 0.3 seconds
- title transitions: 0.5 to 1 second
- golden-ratio camera movement: 2 to 4 seconds

Use rate functions such as:

linear
smooth
rush_into
rush_from
there_and_back

CODE STRUCTURE

Organize the file into reusable sections:

1. color constants
2. stick-figure rig
3. run-cycle pose definitions
4. wireframe orb generator
5. particle generator
6. golden-ratio construction
7. main scene timeline

Add comments explaining each scene and animation stage.

Use deterministic random seeds so the wireframe orb is reproducible.

FINAL RESPONSE

After generating the code, tell me:

- the filename created
- the main scene class name
- the command to preview it
- the command to render it in vertical 1080 x 1920 format
- any required configuration file
Nothing in the catalogue fits, so I wrote the scene. Tell me what to change.

from manim import *
import math

PHI = (1 + 5 ** 0.5) / 2


def stick_figure(center=ORIGIN, scale=1.0, color=WHITE):
    c = np.array(center, dtype=float)

    head = Circle(
        radius=0.22 * scale,
        color=color,
    ).move_to(c + UP * 1.05 * scale)

    body = Line(
        c + UP * 0.82 * scale,
        c - UP * 0.30 * scale,
        color=color,
    )

    arms = VGroup(
        Line(
            c + UP * 0.55 * scale,
            c + LEFT * 0.55 * scale + UP * 0.10 * scale,
            color=color,
        ),
        Line(
            c + UP * 0.55 * scale,
            c + RIGHT * 0.55 * scale + UP * 0.10 * scale,
            color=color,
        ),
    )

    legs = VGroup(
        Line(
            c - UP * 0.30 * scale,
            c + LEFT * 0.52 * scale - DOWN * 0.85 * scale,
            color=color,
        ),
        Line(
            c - UP * 0.30 * scale,
            c + RIGHT * 0.52 * scale - DOWN * 0.85 * scale,
            color=color,
        ),
    )

    return VGroup(head, body, arms, legs)


def wire_orb(center=ORIGIN, radius=1.0, color=BLUE):
    c = np.array(center, dtype=float)

    rings = VGroup(
        *[
            Circle(
                radius=radius * s,
                color=color,
                stroke_opacity=0.65,
            )
            for s in (1.0, 0.72, 0.42)
        ]
    )
    rings.move_to(c)

    meridians = VGroup(
        *[
            Arc(
                radius=radius,
                start_angle=a,
                angle=PI,
                color=color,
                stroke_opacity=0.7,
            ).move_to(c)
            for a in (0, PI / 3, 2 * PI / 3)
        ]
    )

    chords = VGroup(
        *[
            Line(
                c + radius * np.array(
                    [math.cos(a), math.sin(a), 0]
                ),
                c + radius * np.array(
                    [math.cos(a + PI / 2), math.sin(a + PI / 2), 0]
                ),
                color=TEAL,
                stroke_opacity=0.65,
            )
            for a in (0, PI / 4, PI / 2, 3 * PI / 4)
        ]
    )

    dots = VGroup(
        *[
            Dot(
                c + radius * np.array(
                    [math.cos(a), math.sin(a), 0]
                ),
                radius=0.045,
                color=YELLOW,
            )
            for a in np.linspace(0, TAU, 10, endpoint=False)
        ]
    )

    glow = Circle(
        radius=radius * 1.16,
        color=color,
        stroke_opacity=0.16,
        stroke_width=12,
    ).move_to(c)

    return VGroup(glow, rings, meridians, chords, dots)


def golden_construction(center=ORIGIN, scale=1.0):
    c = np.array(center, dtype=float)
    sizes = [
        scale,
        scale / PHI,
        scale / PHI**2,
        scale / PHI**3,
    ]

    squares = VGroup()

    for i, size in enumerate(sizes):
        square = Square(
            side_length=size,
            color=[GOLD, YELLOW, ORANGE, GOLD][i],
            stroke_width=3,
        )
        square.move_to(
            c
            + RIGHT * (scale - size) * 0.42
            + UP * (scale - size) * 0.18
        )
        squares.add(square)

    spiral = VMobject(
        color=ORANGE,
        stroke_width=4,
    )

    points = []

    for k in range(80):
        t = k / 79 * 2.0 * PI
        r = scale * 0.05 + scale * 0.44 * t / (2 * PI)
        points.append(
            c + np.array(
                [
                    r * math.cos(t),
                    r * math.sin(t),
                    0,
                ]
            )
        )

    spiral.set_points_smoothly(points)

    return VGroup(squares, spiral)


class GeneratedScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = BLACK

        title = Text(
            "THE GOLDEN CHASE",
            font_size=44,
            color=GOLD,
        ).to_edge(UP, buff=0.45)

        subtitle = Text(
            "a ratio becomes a path",
            font_size=28,
            color=GREY_B,
        ).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.18)

        self.play(
            FadeIn(title),
            FadeIn(subtitle),
            run_time=1.2,
        )

        hero = stick_figure(
            LEFT * 2.35 + DOWN * 1.55,
            0.78,
            WHITE,
        )

        phi_label = MathTex(
            r"\varphi=\frac{1+\sqrt5}{2}\approx1.618",
            font_size=30,
            color=GOLD,
        ).next_to(hero, UP, buff=0.3)

        orb = wire_orb(
            RIGHT * 1.9 + UP * 0.15,
            0.92,
            BLUE,
        )

        orb_label = Text(
            "the attractor",
            font_size=26,
            color=TEAL,
        ).next_to(orb, DOWN, buff=0.25)

        ramp = Polygon(
            LEFT * 3.5 + DOWN * 2.55,
            RIGHT * 3.3 + DOWN * 2.55,
            RIGHT * 3.3 + DOWN * 1.95,
            color=GREY_B,
            fill_opacity=0.12,
        )

        self.play(
            Create(hero),
            FadeIn(phi_label),
            Create(orb),
            FadeIn(orb_label),
            Create(ramp),
            run_time=2.0,
        )

        trail = TracedPath(
            lambda: orb.get_center(),
            stroke_color=BLUE,
            stroke_width=3,
            dissipating_time=0.8,
        )

        orb_target = RIGHT * 2.15 + DOWN * 0.9

        self.add(trail)

        self.play(
            orb.animate.move_to(orb_target),
            hero.animate.shift(RIGHT * 1.0),
            run_time=2.2,
            rate_func=smooth,
        )

        impact = VGroup(
            *[
                Line(
                    orb_target
                    + 0.9
                    * np.array(
                        [math.cos(a), math.sin(a), 0]
                    ),
                    orb_target
                    + 1.3
                    * np.array(
                        [math.cos(a), math.sin(a), 0]
                    ),
                    color=YELLOW,
                )
                for a in np.linspace(0, TAU, 8, endpoint=False)
            ]
        )

        impact_label = Text(
            "ratio → motion",
            font_size=30,
            color=YELLOW,
        ).to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.55)

        self.play(
            Create(impact),
            FadeIn(impact_label),
            orb.animate.scale(1.2),
            run_time=1.0,
        )

        self.play(
            FadeOut(
                VGroup(
                    title,
                    subtitle,
                    hero,
                    phi_label,
                    orb,
                    orb_label,
                    ramp,
                    impact,
                    impact_label,
                    trail,
                )
            ),
            run_time=0.7,
        )

        construction = golden_construction(
            ORIGIN + DOWN * 0.3,
            3.7,
        )

        fib = MathTex(
            r"1,\ 1,\ 2,\ 3,\ 5,\ 8,\ \ldots",
            font_size=34,
            color=GOLD,
        ).to_edge(UP, buff=0.7)

        fib_label = Text(
            "nested squares trace the same growth",
            font_size=26,
            color=GREY_B,
        ).next_to(fib, DOWN, buff=0.22)

        self.play(
            Create(construction),
            FadeIn(fib),
            FadeIn(fib_label),
            run_time=2.0,
        )

        tracker = ValueTracker(0)

        rotating = always_redraw(
            lambda: golden_construction(
                ORIGIN + DOWN * 0.3,
                3.7,
            ).rotate(
                tracker.get_value(),
                about_point=ORIGIN + DOWN * 0.3,
            )
        )

        self.remove(construction)
        self.add(rotating)

        final_text = Text(
            "ESCAPE THE PATTERN",
            font_size=38,
            color=WHITE,
        ).to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.6)

        self.play(
            tracker.animate.set_value(PI / 2),
            rotating.animate.scale(0.84),
            FadeIn(final_text),
            run_time=1.8,
        )

        self.play(
            FadeOut(
                VGroup(
                    rotating,
                    fib,
                    fib_label,
                    final_text,
                )
            ),
            run_time=0.5,
        )
